provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 747.307 within 5 Days: The provider failed to notify parents of the operation receiving  a safe sleeping deficiency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 747.307 within 5 Days (26 TAC §747.309(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: Upon the inspector's arrival at the operation, two children were observed sleeping in restrictive devices (bouncers).    CI:  The primary caregiver removed the children from the restrictive devices and placed them on sleeping cots.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §747.2326(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The primary caregiver was supervising three children outdoors while a six-month-old infant remained indoors unsupervised.    Corrected:  The primary caregiver corrected the supervision lapse by bringing the other children indoors to supervise the infant and all children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The operation failed to provide the mandatory emergency preparedness plan for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Release of Children: The operation does not have the required operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Release of Children (26 TAC §747.501(1))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Proof of Liability Insurance: The operation was unable to provide documentation verifying that parents had received written notification regarding the absence of liability insurance
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Proof of Liability Insurance (26 TAC §747.801(14))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Screen time was being provided to three children under the age of two years old.    Correction:  The primary caregiver ceased the use of screen time before the end of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver was not in compliance with mandatory annual CPR and First Aid training requirements
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Time Period of Training - Primary Caregiver: A compliance review indicates that the primary caregiver failed to complete the required 30 hours of annual training by the required date.    Correction:  The primary caregiver has submitted the required 30-hour training requirements for the annual year of 1/4/2026?1/4/2027.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Time Period of Training - Primary Caregiver (26 TAC §747.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child is missing immunizations records.
Children's Records Accessible - to Caregiver: The primary caregiver did not have records for two children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Accessible - to Caregiver (26 TAC §747.601(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The cat did not have shot records or a health statement from a veterinarian.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: During review of the fire safety the fire extinguisher was not mounted as required.
Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There is no documentation of the monthly fire drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver has not had any training for the year of 2021 and 2022
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: During my inspection I observed a child lying in a KidsII rocker which is listed as recalled on CPSC.     Corrected:  The product was removed out of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §747.3935(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the inspection I observed a pair of scissors and a box cutter that was in a drawer that was not secured by a safety latch, making them accesible to the children.    Corrected:  The scissors and box cutter was removed from the drawer and put in a safe place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: I observed one childs file  not to  have a food allergy emergency plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §747.3619)
